# Forland & Company Advocates

> Forland & Company Advocates is a Nairobi-based Kenyan law firm providing practical legal advice to businesses, investors and individuals.

Canonical website: https://forlandcompanyadvocates.co.ke/
Location: Landmark Plaza, 4th Floor, Left Wing, Argwings Kodhek Road, Nairobi, Kenya
Email: forlandcompanyadvocates@gmail.com
Telephone: +254 713 001 575

## Important notice

Website content is general information and does not constitute legal advice. Viewing the site or sending an inquiry does not create an advocate-client relationship. Do not send confidential or time-sensitive information before the firm confirms an engagement.
